warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the canonical Poisson-bracket phase-space transport (Hamiltonian streaming through the `canonical_pb` kernels), the LTE projection and the implicit BGK update that 28 of the module's drivers use. In `rt_can_pb_neut_bgk_sodshock_im_1x1v_p2.c`, `nl` (line 64) is the density on the left of the discontinuity, so it sets the shock strength and every graded history; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong Hamiltonian flux, a mis-assembled implicit BGK relaxation or a wrong LTE moment changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 2.8e-4 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 5.0e-4 (worst files `neut-energy-moment.gkyl` and `neut-energy-moment.gkyl`), a headroom of about 2008x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
